title: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost
abstract: arXiv:2611.02079v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents without modifying model weights, but existing methods primarily optimize response quality. Extending them to joint quality--cost optimization introduces a challenge: applying the deployment preference during intermediate updates can prematurely reject candidates that are valuable for later improvements. We introduce ParetoSaddler, which addresses this mismatch by separating intermediate candidate promotion from final deployment selection. At each iteration, an optimizer updates a parent harness to produce a candidate, and then compares the two over repeated executions and uses Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support to promote candidates showing credible progress in either quality or cost. Promoted candidates receive broader development evaluation and remain available as parents for later optimization steps. We evaluate ParetoSaddler on ClawMark and GAIA2 using domain-disjoint splits.

translated_title: ParetoSaddler：面向质量与成本的智能体框架帕累托引导优化
translated_abstract: 智能体框架优化无需修改模型权重即可显著提升LLM智能体的表现，但现有方法主要优化响应质量。将其扩展到质量与成本的联合优化会带来一个挑战：在中间更新阶段应用部署偏好可能会过早地拒绝那些对后续改进有价值的候选方案。我们提出ParetoSaddler，通过将中间候选方案的晋升与最终部署选择相分离来解决这一不匹配问题。在每次迭代中，优化器更新一个父框架以产生候选方案，随后通过多次重复执行对二者进行比较，并利用贝叶斯自助帕累托支持来晋升那些在质量或成本上展现出可信进展的候选方案。被晋升的候选方案将接受更广泛的开发集评估，并保持可用状态以作为后续优化步骤的父框架。我们在ClawMark和GAIA2上采用领域不相交的数据划分对ParetoSaddler进行了评估。
tldr: 提出ParetoSaddler方法，通过将中间候选晋升与最终部署选择分离，并借助贝叶斯自助帕累托支持机制，在无需修改模型权重的情况下实现LLM智能体框架的质量与成本联合优化。
en_tdlr: ParetoSaddler enables joint quality-cost optimization of LLM agent harnesses without modifying model weights by separating intermediate candidate promotion from final deployment selection, using Bayesian bootstrap Pareto support to promote candidates showing credible progress in either quality or cost.
